description: Source code for a reftable writer module, implementing functions for writing, flushing, and managing reftable data structures, including index and log sections.

classes.name: obj_index_tree_node
classes.description: Represents a node in the object index tree, containing a hash and associated offsets.

methods.name: writer_reftable_block_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics for a specific block type within the writer.

methods.name: padded_write
methods.description: Writes data with optional padding, handling pending padding bytes.

methods.name: options_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default options for the reftable writer if not already specified.

methods.name: writer_version
methods.description: Determines the version of the writer based on hash ID.

methods.name: writer_write_header
methods.description: Writes the header for the reftable, including version, block size, and hash ID.

methods.name: writer_reinit_block_writer
methods.description: Reinitializes the block writer for a specific block type.

methods.name: reftable_writer_new
methods.description: Creates a new reftable writer instance with specified write and flush functions.

methods.name: reftable_writer_set_limits
methods.description: Sets minimum and maximum update index limits for the writer.

methods.name: writer_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the writer.

methods.name: reftable_writer_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the writer.

methods.name: writer_finish_section
methods.description: Finalizes a section, writing index blocks if necessary.

methods.name: writer_dump_object_index
methods.description: Dumps the object index into the writer, creating object records.

methods.name: writer_finish_public_section
methods.description: Finishes writing the public section, including dumping object index if needed.

methods.name: reftable_writer_close
methods.description: Closes the writer, writing footer and releasing resources.

methods.name: writer_clear_index
methods.description: Clears the index records from the writer.

methods.name: writer_flush_nonempty_block
methods.description: Flushes a non-empty block to storage, updating index records.

methods.name: writer_flush_block
methods.description: Flushes the current block if it contains data.
